entities.summary: Tokujin Yoshioka (b. 1967-01-20, Saga) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Saga and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
